assertions.statement: The storefront loads and shows four products with no credentials configured.
assertions.howToVerify: Open /. Confirm four product cards render and no error banner is visible.

assertions.statement: Requesting the pay endpoint without payment returns HTTP 402 with a WWW-Authenticate: Payment header naming the hedera method.
assertions.howToVerify: Request /api/pay?product=tee with Accept: application/json. Confirm status 402 and that the WWW-Authenticate header contains method="hedera" and intent="charge".

assertions.statement: A funded test signer completes a USDC charge on Hedera testnet and the endpoint then returns 200 with a Payment-Receipt header.
assertions.howToVerify: Drive the Hedera checkout path in the browser with the injected burner wallet, then confirm the mirror node records the token transfer and the retried request returns 200 carrying Payment-Receipt.

assertions.statement: The receipt page shows the settled payment with a Hashscan link to the transaction.
assertions.howToVerify: After C3, open the receipt page and confirm a hashscan.io/testnet link is present and points at the settling transaction.

assertions.statement: A single 402 challenge advertises both the hedera and stripe methods.
assertions.howToVerify: Request /api/pay?product=tee with Accept: application/json and confirm the WWW-Authenticate header contains two Payment challenges, one with method="hedera" and one with method="stripe".

assertions.statement: Requesting the pay endpoint from a browser returns an HTML payment page, and without Stripe credentials that page is an honestly disabled demo-mode panel rather than a broken card form.
assertions.howToVerify: Navigate to /api/pay?product=tee with Accept: text/html and confirm an HTML page renders rather than raw JSON. If Stripe credentials are ABSENT, confirm the page contains the text 'demo mode', names STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY and STRIPE_NETWORK_ID, and that its pay control carries a disabled attribute. If Stripe credentials are PRESENT, confirm a Stripe Elements card input renders and the pay control is enabled.
